Source: Dungeons and Dragon Ballz V.3, PDF page 132. Category: technique. Rank 2.

Rank 2 Melee technique
Ki Cost: 25 ki
Casting Prerequisite: 1 Simple or Martial Weapon
that you are proficient with.
Casting Time: 1 Action
Range: Weapon’s Range
Duration: Instantaneous
Chargeable: Yes
Make 3 combo attack rolls dealing your equipped
weapon’s damage die + 1d6 each on a hit.
